(iii) m- nitroaniline

questions.solution:
Basicity is directly proportional to the +M,+I effect, but it is inversely proportional to the -M,-I effect. Aniline is the highest basic because it does not have any group. But the nitro group can show the -I and -M effect. The nitro group at meta position show only the -I effect. But at ortho and para position, it will show the -M,-I effect both. So, the m-nitroaniline is more basic than the p-nitroaniline and o-nitroaniline.

Hence, the decreasing order of basicity is  (i) >(iii)>(iv)>(ii).

Hence, the incorrect matching amongst the following is H2O,NH3.

According to the Freundlich isotherm, thevariation of extent of adsorption (x/m) with pressure (P) was given mathematically by Freundlich.Where n can take any whole number value which depends uponthe nature of adsorbate and adsorbent. The above relationship is
also called Freundlich’s adsorption isotherm.

xm=kP1n

At very high pressure, xm=k, it is independent of the pressure.

Physical adsorption (i.e. physisorption) :-

When the particles of the adsorbate are held to the surface of the adsorbent by the physical forces such as van der Waal’s forces, the adsorption is called physical adsorption or vanderwaals adsorption. Physical adsorption is non-selective. It is reversible and occur rapidly. It has the ∆H<0.
Chemical adsorption (i.e. chemisorption) :-
When the molecules of the adsorbate are held to the surface of the adsorbent by the chemical forces, the adsorption is called chemical adsorption. It is irreversible and occur slowly. It has the ∆H<0.

questions.solution:
Tom and Jerry play a game of alternately throwing an unfair coin. First one to get head wins.

The coin is unfair, hence, let, the probability of getting a head when the coin is tossed is x then the probability of getting a tail when the coin is tossed is 1-x.

If Tom starts the game, he has 62.5%=62.5100=58 chance of winning the game.

He can win the game in first toss of the coin or second toss or third toss and so on means the cases are H or TTH or TTTTH or TTTTTTH and so on.

Thus, the probability of Tom winning the game is

x+1-x×1-x×x+1-x×1-x×1-x×1-x×x+...=58

⇒x+1-x2x+1-x4x+1-x6x+...=58

Using the sum of infinite terms of a geometric progression i.e. a+ar+ar2+ar3+...=a1-r,

⇒x1-1-x2=58

⇒8x=51-1-x2

⇒8x=51-1+2x-x2

⇒8x=52x-x2

⇒8x=10x-5x2

⇒5x2-2x=0

⇒x=0 or x=25.

But x=0 is not possible, hence the probability of getting a head is 25.

Now if this coin is tossed 5 times, then the probability of getting exactly 3 heads can be obtained by using Binomial distribution i.e.

PX=r=Crnprqn-r, where n=5, p=25, q=35, r=3.

PX=3=C35·253·352

⇒PX=3=5!3!×2!·8125·925

⇒PX=3=5×4×3!3!×2×1·8125·925

⇒PX=3=10·8125·925=144625.

questions.q: One angstrom <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mo>∘</mo></mover></mfenced></math> is equal to:
questions.solution: The angstrom or angstrom is a metric unit of length equal to  <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>10</mn></mrow></msup><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></math>; that is, one ten-billionth of a metre, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>1</mn></math> nanometre, or <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>100</mn></math> picometres. Its symbol is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Å</mi></math>, a letter of the Swedish alphabet. The angstrom is not a part of the SI system of units, but it can be considered part of the metric system in general.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.q: The wave front is a surface in which
options: all points are in the same phase
there are pairs of points in opposite phase
there are pairs of points with phase difference <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>(</mo><mi>π</mi><mo>/</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>)</mo></math>
there is no relation between the phases
questions.solution:
A wave front is a surface over which an optical wave has a constant phase (i.e. there is no phase difference).
Or such a surface which envelopes the particles that are in the same state of vibration is known as a wave front.
The wave front at any instant is defined as the locus of all the particles of the medium which are in the same state of vibration.

In physics, power is the amount of energy transferred or converted per unit time.

Power, P=m×g×ht
